releaseNotes: Fixes Claude API keys being rejected. Settings -> Test Connection failed with a confusing "Input should be a valid array" error even when the key was perfectly valid - the app was sending an empty system field that the Anthropic API refuses. It is now omitted, and Claude keys work.
Only Claude was affected, and only the Test Connection button. Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini and Deepseek were never involved, and Claude predictions and chat already worked once a key was saved.
